sources.title: Gemma 4 model card | Google AI for Developers - ai.google.dev
sources.snippet: Gemma 4 features a context window of up to 256K tokens and maintains multilingual support in over 140 languages. Featuring both Dense and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures, Gemma 4 is well-suited for tasks like text generation, coding, and reasoning. The models are available in five distinct sizes: E2B, E4B, 12B, 26B A4B, and 31B.

sources.snippet: Open Gemma instruction model for efficient chat and self-hosted deployments. Compare Gemma 4 E4B IT from Google across 2 providers. Specs include 131,072 token context; 8,192 token output; $0.02 / $0.10 per 1M tokens; input: text, image, audio; output: text; tool calling.
